# Direct dependencies for the drift half of the pipeline.
# THIS IS THE CANONICAL FILE. Install from this one.
#
#   Python >= 3.11 required.  Ubuntu 20.04 ships 3.8, which is end-of-life and
#   cannot install these versions at all -- see D017 in the vault. Bring your own
#   interpreter on the cluster (micromamba/uv), and NOT onto /home, which is
#   1.7 GB and shared.
#
# Verified working 2026-09-10 on Windows 11 / CPython 3.13.1, against a real
# ARCO-ERA5 pull and a real NOAA GDP pull. These are the versions that actually
# produced era5_17-36N_82-63W_20210101-20210108.nc (13.7 MB, 192 hourly steps)
# and 926,533 drifter observations.
#
# Install:
#   uv venv .venv --python 3.13         (or: python -m venv .venv)
#   uv pip install -r env/requirements.txt
#
# Only direct dependencies are pinned here, so this resolves on Linux as well as
# Windows. For the exact local tree see requirements-lock-win.txt, and read the
# warning at the top of it before using it anywhere but Windows.

xarray==2026.7.0
zarr==3.3.0             # 3.x; see the consolidated= note below
gcsfs==2026.8.0         # anonymous access to ARCO-ERA5 on Google Cloud
fsspec==2026.7.0
netcdf4==1.7.4
cftime==1.6.5
dask==2026.8.0          # scheduler="threads" is what makes the ARCO pull tractable
numpy==2.5.3
pandas==3.0.5
pyarrow==25.0.1         # derived-tier Parquet
scipy==1.18.1
matplotlib==3.11.1
erddapy==3.3.0          # NOAA GDP drifters (plain HTTPS also works)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Two things that cost real time if you do not know them. Both are measured,
# not inherited from a documentation page.
#
# 1. ARCO-ERA5 is Zarr FORMAT 2 despite ".zarr-v3" in its path. With zarr 3.x
#    installed you MUST pass consolidated=True:
#
#        xr.open_zarr(url, storage_options={"token": "anon"}, consolidated=True)
#
#    Without it, open_zarr never returns -- no error, no output, it just hangs.
#
# 2. Its variables use full CF names, not the CDS/GRIB short codes:
#       10m_u_component_of_wind, 10m_v_component_of_wind, mean_sea_level_pressure
#    Asking for "10u" raises KeyError. Beware 10m_u_component_of_NEUTRAL_wind,
#    which is a different quantity sitting right next to it alphabetically.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Not yet installed or verified -- added by whoever needs them, with a version:
#   cartopy              coastlines for the currents quiver check (R3f)
#   astral               daylight window (D012)
#   gymnasium            RL environment (R5a)
#   stable-baselines3    PPO (R5c) -- note it pulls in torch, ~1-3 GB
